description: Header file defining the NetworkChangeNotifierMac class for monitoring network changes on macOS, including nested Forwarder class, methods for reachability and configuration change handling, and related data members.

classes.name: NetworkChangeNotifierMac
classes.description: Class for monitoring network changes on macOS, inheriting from NetworkChangeNotifier, managing reachability and configuration change notifications.

classes.name: NetworkChangeNotifierMac::Forwarder
classes.description: Nested class acting as a delegate to handle network configuration change callbacks and interface with NetworkChangeNotifierMac.

methods.name: GetCurrentConnectionType
methods.description: Returns the current network connection type.

methods.name: CalculateConnectionType
methods.description: Static method to determine connection type based on network flags.

methods.name: SetDynamicStoreNotificationKeys
methods.description: Sets notification keys for dynamic store updates.

methods.name: ReachabilityCallback
methods.description: Static callback invoked on reachability status changes.

methods.name: NetworkChangeCalculatorParamsMac
methods.description: Returns network change calculator parameters specific to macOS.
